correctness.rationale: The center scalar of an idempotent is 0 or 1: in the latter case the induced map is invertible and idempotent and the central functional vanishes, giving the identity. In the former case the quotient image W is isotropic and the functional factors through projection along U. Central shears remove it. W and Z=U^perp have a perfect cross-pairing and W⊕Z is nondegenerate; dual bases and extension to the orthogonal complement give orbit equivalence exactly at equal r and rank of the alternating form on Z, including characteristic two. In local Witt coordinates the restriction map is A-A^T+L^TJ_0 L up to conventions; selecting one strictly triangular half of A proves surjectivity in every characteristic. Counting the radical and nondegenerate form on the quotient yields the claimed orbit counts. The image map and local splittings give affine bundles over the isotropic Grassmannian, and idempotent ranks are locally constant. A corank-k alternating form stratum has codimension binom(k,2) by choosing its radical and a nondegenerate quotient form; the restriction map is locally an affine projection after translating A. The bounded fresh replay below confirms the finite counts and, for n=2 over F_2, actual conjugation orbit sizes.
residual_risks: Finite replay is not a proof over all fields or of the geometry; the algebraic reconstruction covers those claims on the stated reduced variety. No nonreduced scheme or restricted-Lie claims were reviewed.
